title: 第1403章 去吃辣鸡火锅第1402章 破天之术
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
林东方没有照搬他脑海里的那套理论。
因为这套理论有个基础。
生产力。
生产力上不去，别的都是无根之萍。
也只有生产力上去了，百姓都开始接受教育了，才能更好的把计划推进下去。
极宙圣王叹道，“四位圣帝竭泽而渔完全吸干了三十六域的灵根，未来的末法时代会更加严峻。”
散会后，林东方来到金可儿面前，“师姐，接下来一段时间要辛苦你了，多多巡视三十五域，哪里有饥荒就派些粮食。”
说到这里他不免有些歉疚，事情都是他牵头的，但最累的活儿留给金可儿了。
而且还很危险，万一被三大盟的圣王抓了落单…
想到这里，林东方赶紧取出三面阵旗。
“师姐你拿着防身用。”
这些阵旗都是徐山老爷子亲手祭炼的，自然认可金可儿的气息。
金可儿笑着接过阵旗说道，“你放心好了，有师尊的法宝，他们三个一起来也不会是我的对手。”
整理了粮食，金可儿就出发了。
三十五域幅员辽阔，每一分一秒都会发生各种变故，只有金可儿才有这个实力及时救场。
当然极宙圣王也行，但他现在状态不稳，还是休养一阵再说。
“呼，明天开始有的忙了。”
林东方回了书院后面的小院儿，才真正放松下来。
在百姓面前唠嗑说话，感觉比和黑甲圣子他们生死搏杀都紧张。
“整点啥吃好呢！”

紧张了小半天，肚子还真饿了。
帝圣心还没回她的大夏国，和沈倾月在院子外探头探脑的往里面瞧。
帝圣心小声道，“师父出门了。”
“是啊，师父出门了，就留下师叔在家。”
沈倾月严肃点头。
帝圣心捏着手指扭捏说道，“咋办，怪紧张的，请师叔出去吃饭是不是唐突了。”
“有可能唐突，但唐突他不太可能吧…师叔还是挺喜欢热闹的？”
沈倾月也有点拿捏不准。
要是直接进院子，那林东方肯定会给她们也做好吃的。
但那样就是蹭饭了！
总蹭饭也有点不好意思。
于是她俩想着请林东方出去吃。
磨蹭了好一会儿，见林东方系上围裙了，帝圣心也不管那么多了，直接吆喝道，“师叔，咱们出去吃饭呀？”
“出去吃？”
content_en:
Lin Dongfang did not copy the theory in his mind.
Because this theory has a basis.
productive forces.
If productivity cannot increase, everything else will be rootless.
Only when productivity increases and people begin to receive education can the plan be better promoted.
The Holy King of Jizhou sighed, "The four Holy Emperors have completely sucked up the spiritual roots of the Thirty-six Domains, and the future Age of Dharma Ending will be even more severe."
After the meeting, Lin Dongfang came to Jin Keer and said, "Senior sister, I will have to work hard for you in the next period of time. Please patrol the thirty-fifth region more and send some food wherever there is famine."
Speaking of this, he couldn't help but feel a little guilty. He took the lead in everything, but the most tiring work was left to Jin Ke'er.
And it’s very dangerous, if you are caught by the Holy Kings of the three major alliances and left alone...
Thinking of this, Lin Dongfang quickly took out three formation flags.
"Sister, take it for self-defense."
These formation flags were all personally made by Mr. Xu Shan, so he naturally recognized Jin Keer's aura.
Jin Keer smiled and took the formation flag and said, "Don't worry, with Master's magic weapon, the three of them together will not be my opponent."
After sorting out the food, Jin Keer set off.
The Thirty-Fifth Domain is vast, and all kinds of changes happen every minute. Only Jin Keer has the strength to save the situation in time.
Of course, Jizhou Saint King can do it, but his current condition is unstable, so he should rest for a while.
"Huh, I'll be very busy tomorrow."
Lin Dongfang returned to the small courtyard behind the academy and truly relaxed.
Chatting in front of the people felt more nervous than fighting the Black-armored Holy Son and the others in a life-and-death fight.
“What’s the best thing to eat!”
After being nervous for a long time, I was really hungry.
Emperor Shengxin had not yet returned to her Daxia Kingdom, and she and Shen Qingyue were outside the courtyard, peering inside.
Emperor Shengxin whispered, "Master is out."
"Yes, Master went out and left Uncle Master at home."
Shen Qingyue nodded seriously.
Emperor Shengxin pinched his fingers and said, "What should I do? I'm so nervous. Isn't it rude to invite my uncle out for dinner?"
"It's possible to be abrupt, but it's unlikely that he would be abrupt...Uncle Master still likes the excitement, right?"
Shen Qingyue was also a little unsure.
If they went directly into the courtyard, Lin Dongfang would definitely prepare delicious food for them.
But that would be a waste of money!
It’s a bit embarrassing to always have a meal.
So they thought about inviting Lin Dongfang out to eat.
After dawdling for a while, seeing Lin Dongfang put on an apron, the Emperor's Holy Heart didn't care so much and shouted directly, "Uncle, shall we go out to eat?"
"Eating out?"
